title: Beauty and the Beach
meta_description: Welcome to Beauty and the Beach! A stylish 4BR with game room, 4th-floor deck, gulf views \& pool---steps from beaches, dining \& adventures!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Beauty and the Beach is located in the lovely Grande Pointe community within Inlet Beach. This four-level home has everything you could hope for in a vacation home by the sea, with four bedrooms, four full bathrooms and two half baths. The third floor features a game room with a pool table, fridge and wet bar but don't stop there, head on up to the fourth floor to relax on the amazing deck and enjoy the incredible gulf views. This home is a stunner and one you will want to visit year after year!

ABOUT THE AREA: Grande Pointe community is located in Inlet Beach and offers the tranquility you need to rejuvenate from your busy life yet experience as many activities as you desire along our stunning Emerald Coast. This coastal community has a saltwater pool and a dock right on Lake Powell where you can launch your paddle board, kayak, canoe, jet skis or fishing poles. There are many options for food and shopping at 30Avenue shop, which are just around the corner.

BEACH ACCESS: There are four public beaches just a short distance away. Right across Highway 98 is Inlet Beach Access! Visit www.sowal.com for more information on beaches, 30A communities and restaurants.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 10
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 King, ensuite
• Bunk Room -- 2 Full/Full bunks and singles, hallway bath
• Bedroom 4 -- 1 Queen, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Community Pool (unheated)
• 2 Bikes
• Master on Main
• Pool table
• Outdoor 4th floor living room with TV
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker -- pods and drip
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 3 parking spaces and a garage.
- Street parking is not allowed. Vehicles parked on the street may be towed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
